item.title: Gilroy mother hit in crosswalk Jan. 16 dies from injuries
item.description: A woman who was hit by a vehicle while crossing a street in Gilroy last week has died from injuries she suffered in the collision. item.title: Gilroy residents push for crosswalk safety
